::: ### About

I consider myself a hybrid professional, with a strong background in ecology and data analysis. I am a passionate educator and thoroughly enjoy chances to teach and learn with audiences of all levels of prior experience. And I like to see the glass as half full: a positive attitude is my key to living in this world. Away from science, I produce Traditional balsamic vinegar of Modena — you can get more information about my production here.
